mapper.select: select count(*) from voucher_log where memnum = #{memNum} and enddate >= now()
mapper.insert: insert into voucher_log ( memnum, membername, startdate, enddate ) values ( #{memNum}, #{memberName}, str_to_date(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), str_to_date(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
mapper.select: select usageid, memnum, empnum, status, countchange, salesid, createdat from pt_log where salesid = #{salesId} and status = '충전'

select case when ifnull(sum( case when status = '소비' then -countchange when status = '예약취소' then countchange else 0 end ), 0) >= ifnull(sum( case when status = '충전' and salesid < #{salesId} then countchange when status in ('부분환불','전체환불') and salesid <= #{salesId} then countchange else 0 end ), 0) then 1 else 0 end as turnreached from pt_log where memnum = #{memNum}
mapper.insert: insert into pt_log ( memnum, empnum, status, countchange, createdat, salesid, regid ) values ( #{memNum, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{empNum, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, '예약취소', 1, now(), null, #{regId, jdbcType=NULL} )
mapper.select: select usageid, memnum, empnum, status, countchange, createdat, salesid, regid from pt_log where regid = #{regId} and status = '소비'

select v.voucherid as voucherId, v.memnum as memNum, v.membername as memberName, date_format(v.startdate, '%Y-%m-%d') as startDate, date_format(v.enddate, '%Y-%m-%d') as endDate, case when v.enddate >= curdate() then '유효' else '만료' end as validity from voucher_log v where 1=1
and v.memnum = #{memNum}
and v.startdate >= str_to_date(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and v.enddate < date_add(str_to_date(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day)
and v.enddate >= curdate()
and v.enddate < curdate()
order by v.membername asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from voucher_log v where 1=1
and v.startdate >= str_to_date(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and v.enddate < date_add(str_to_date(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), interval 1 day)
and v.memnum = #{memNum}
and v.enddate >= curdate()
and v.enddate < curdate()
